method: Determine the regular six-degree UTM longitude zone with floor((longitude + 180) / 6) + 1, clamping longitude 180 to zone 60. Apply the standard Norway exception from 56°N up to 64°N and 3°E up to 12°E, and the four Svalbard exceptions from 72°N up to 84°N. Assign latitude bands C through X from 80°S up to 84°N, excluding I and O; band X is twelve degrees tall. This selects a grid zone only and does not project coordinates or transform datums.
